title: land waits for a finished headless worker's SessionEnd hook before refusing a live process in its worktree
goal: Found in SP-d3hybrlv: right after the headless worker of ST-7yahfn3j exited, land stopped at step branch naming a live python3 in its worktree (the session's own end hook, gone seconds later); a rerun landed. land waits a bounded time for a process whose parent claude session has exited before refusing, and names it as a hook when it is one.
